title: Test Gap: Test upgrade path for T2 devices
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the test gap

We should be able to do test upgrade path for chassis devices, instead of a random dut it should test supervisor node upgrade, then test LC upgrades in parallel

### Affected Area

T2 / Chassis devices

### Impact of missing tests and proposed tests

No coverage for T2 upgrade path, implement test_upgrade_path_t2 (and other related)

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?

#### How did you do it?
Add test_upgrade_path_t2 testcase to test_upgrade_path.py based on previous upgrade path tests
#### How did you verify/test it?

Please run using variables:
- --upgrade_type=cold
- --base_image_list=<FROM IMAGE URL> 
- --target_image_list=<TO IMAGE URL>

e.g.
```
sudo ./run_tests.sh -i <INV FILE> -n <TB NAME> -m individual -l INFO -e '--showlocals --assert plain -rav --enable_cpa --upgrade_type=cold --skip_sanity --base_image_list=<FROM IMAGE URL> --target_image_list=<TO IMAGE URL>' -u -c upgrade_path/test_upgrade_path.py::test_upgrade_path_t2
```
